title: Building effective agents
text: Workflows are systems where LLMs and tools are orchestrated through predefined code paths. Agents are systems where LLMs dynamically direct their own processes and tool usage. The most successful implementations use simple, composable patterns. Patterns: prompt chaining, routing, parallelization, orchestrator-workers, evaluator-optimizer.

title: What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?
text: MCP is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external systems such as data sources, tools and workflows. It works like a USB-C port for AI applications.

title: LangGraph human-in-the-loop
text: The interrupt function pauses graph execution and waits for human input; state is saved by a checkpointer so execution can resume later, enabling approval of tool calls before they run.

title: CrewAI introduction
text: CrewAI offers Crews, teams of autonomous role-playing agents, and Flows, event-driven workflows that give precise control. Flows can orchestrate Crews.
